_about: Auto engine of card G (multimodal_experiments/mm/glaze_decision.py): the recipe engine for each kind of query, chosen on recipes no model trained on by scripts/eval_glaze_engines.py. Read at every Auto search (no restart needed). A new evaluation = a new version here and a new dated document.
_engines: smart = smart search (the joint model) · colour_match = the text-chemistry model as it is · colour_ranking = colour match with its learned part off (colour_ranking_weights)

why.photo_words_formula: With a photo, words or a formula, smart search finds the recipe far more often (typed sentence: in the top 10 for 79 % vs 43 % with colour match) and gives more results of the same colour and surface.
why.menus: With only the colour, cone and surface menus, colour match gives the most results with both the same colour and the same surface (63 % vs 54 % smart search); it finds the exact recipe a little less often (MRR 0.31 vs 0.34).
why.colour: With only a colour, the plain CIEDE2000 colour ranking beats both learned models: 88 % of the results in the same colour (smart search 59 %) and the recipe found more often (MRR 0.14 vs 0.11).

_colour_ranking_weights: colour match weights with the learned part off: latent, CIEDE2000 colour, surface, cone (sum 1)
